name: Hotel St. George Helsinki
positioning: Design Hotels member in a restored landmark building across from Old Church Park in central Helsinki, with an art collection, a spa and an indoor pool
best_for: Art and design lovers wanting a base in the heart of Helsinki
Wellness-minded travelers who want a spa, an indoor pool and a gym open around the clock

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a restored landmark building directly across from Old Church Park in the heart of Helsinki.
Hotel St. George is a member of Design Hotels.
The hotel's art program is run in collaboration with the Helsinki Art Museum and the National Gallery.
The St. George spa offers facilities for both mental and physical wellbeing.
Spa treatments include massages, facials and body scrubs, and the spa has a plunge pool.
The hotel has an indoor pool on property.
The Playground gym is open to hotel guests 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
The fitness facilities include sauna rooms and steam rooms.
The Church Park Suite is a one-bedroom junior suite with a garden view.
The Coupole Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a city view and a balcony.
Wintergarden Restaurant & Bar is meant as the living room of locals and guests alike.
Room service and turndown service are offered.

highlights.text: The art collection includes a large-scale dragon sculpture by Chinese artist Ai Weiwei.
The Sky Attic Studio is a top-floor studio with city views.
The St. George Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a garden view and a balcony.
Restaurant Boon Nam, by chef Tomi Björck, serves Thai food in a relaxed atmosphere.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
Parking is off-site, at Aimo Park Erottaja nearby.
The spa and the Playground gym are for guests aged 16 and over.
